The Power of Compounding

Compounding is the process where the value of an investment grows because the earnings on that investment earn interest as time passes. It is often called the eighth wonder of the world.

The key ingredient is time. An investor who starts early and stays patient will usually beat a more talented investor who starts late, simply because the curve bends upward after many years.

Small, regular contributions matter more than perfect timing. Automating savings removes emotion from the process and lets compounding do the heavy lifting over decades.
